items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Arnold, I told you, did I Want to Thank You, Lord, with a choir... He did it for Victor... So I've had some good songs, you know. I mean good people do my material.

ctx.x: See? So I got my song back. And let me see. What's the other one? Not-Thank You, Lord. I'll have to look at my list because so many -- I've had so many people record so many good songs -- so many -- good people record them, you know.
And then let me see what else. No, that was before Mahalia -- Eddie Arnold, I told you, did I Want to Thank You, Lord, with a choir, didn't I?
